item.description: That law was intended to preserve important privacy protections for Epstein’s victims.

item.title: Nike faces federal probe over allegations of ‘DEI-related’ discrimination against white workers
item.description: Nike called the subpoena a surprising escalation.

item.title: CIA ends publication of its popular World Factbook reference tool
item.description: The agency announced the decision Wednesday but gave no reason for it.

item.title: The Washington Post’s sports section was a gold standard, all the way to the end
item.description: The Washington Post sports section died Wednesday. Whether you blame natural causes or more avoidable factors, the loss for the D.C. area is immense.

item.title: Syla Swords scores 28, No. 8 Michigan beats Nebraska ahead of Big Ten showdown against No. 2 UCLA
item.description: Syla Swords scored 28 points and Olivia Olson had 21 to help No. 8 Michigan pull away and beat Nebraska 88-76 on Wednesday night.

item.title: Okananwa’s 23 points help No. 22 Maryland women upset No. 12 Michigan State women 86-70
item.description: Oluchi Okananwa scored 23 points, and the No. 22 Maryland women pulled away in the second half for an 86-70 win over No. 12 Michigan State on Wednesday.

item.title: Tigers pull off late free-agent stunner, landing top pitcher on market
item.description: The Detroit Tigers have pulled off a bold, last-minute addition to their rotation by landing the top pitcher remaining on the market. The Tigers have agreed to a three-year, $115 million deal with veteran right-hander Framber Valdez, ESPN first reported on Wednesday night.

item.title: Minnesota upsets No. 10 Michigan State 76-73, fending off late Spartans surge to stop 7-game skid
item.description: Jaylen Crocker-Johnson had 22 points and seven rebounds to help Minnesota fend off a late surge by 10th-ranked Michigan State and secure a 76-73 upset on Wednesday night.

item.title: Detroit Catholic Central’s Samson Gash inks with Spartans on National Signing Day
item.description: Michigan State added a gem to its class on Wednesday by getting the signature of Detroit Catholic Central speedster Samson Gash.

item.title: Prep Roundup: South Lyon East runs record to 15-0 by handling Milford
item.description: In a meeting of this year's top Lakes Valley Conference girls hoops teams, undefeated South Lyon East won 50-45 at Milford on Tuesday night.
